shard: Spain and Portugal: every pending row of scripts/data/rosterConfirmation2026.json whose club plays in La Liga or the Primeira Liga as Club Manager models them for 2026-27 (48 rows at origin/main 5f2622fd: Spain 31, Portugal 17)
method: Each row was read on the web on 2026-10-03 with WebFetch and WebSearch only, never a wiki. A row leaves pending only when an official page (family A: the LaLiga player or match page, the Liga Portugal page, a club's own squad page or announcement, or a governing body such as the AFC) and an independent publisher on another host (family B: Soccerway, FotMob, ESPN) agree where the man is. Birth dates are in the note so a namesake cannot be mistaken for him. A season-long loanee is placed at the club he plays for, with loan and loanFrom as information only, the ledger's loanPolicy. The to field is the Club Manager club name the bake knows; realClub is the club as the sources write it. This file is folded into rosterConfirmation2026.json by the lead; nothing reads it directly.

pending.name: Renato Sanches
pending.note: Checked 2026-10-03 and left pending, but he is certainly not at Benfica: Benfica's own 2026-27 squad page (https://www.slbenfica.pt/en-us/futebol/plantel-principal) and ESPN's (https://www.espn.com/soccer/team/squad/_/id/1929) both leave him out. Born 1997-08-18. Benfica was only a 2024-25 loan from PSG; he spent 2025-26 on loan at Panathinaikos (announced by the club on 2025-08-24, https://www.pao.gr/en/transfer/renato-sanches-is-green/) and Soccerway (https://us.soccerway.com/player/sanches-renato/Kbo7UsAS/transfers) records his return to PSG on 2026-06-30. But PSG's own 2026-27 squad page (https://www.psg.fr/en/mens-football/players) and ESPN's PSG page (https://www.espn.com/soccer/team/squad/_/id/160) both leave him out too, FotMob (https://www.fotmob.com/players/589344/renato-sanches) shows nothing after the loan, and no source found names a 2026-27 club or says he is unattached. The safe in-game effect is removal from Benfica; which list he belongs in needs a source for where he is.
